document_title: Process Characterization Plan — Low-pH Viral Inactivation (Step 6)
schema_note: Blocks validate against nlp_reports app/models; parameter_type, document_type, QualityAttribute criticality fields, StudyDesign and DesignSpace are local extensions (see schema_extensions_used).
schema_extensions_used: RevisionEntry / GroundTruthAnnex.supersedes (new) — the revision layer, anchored on the rendered revision-history rows
AcceptanceCriterionRecord (new) — step acceptance criteria tagged with the revision that applied them and whether they are in force or superseded
out_of_schema_notes: Classification is a result of the study, so every parameter_type is 'unclassified'. ProcessParameter.target_value and NOR are the set-point and NOR the studies were planned against, which the plan prints; the set-points and NORs that PCR-006 Version 2.0 put in force are statements anchored on the notes of the parameter table. ProcessParameter.PAR carries the range studied, as everywhere in the corpus; the plan claims no proven acceptable range.

The nrCE-SDS re-test of retained samples S-VI-RET has no StudyDesign.study_type; it appears as rows of the schedule and sampling tables and as a statement. Studies of the step that started after INV-001 opened (hold, confirmation and support studies) are not studies of this plan; PCR-006 records each as a discrepancy.

acceptance_criteria holds the rows of the criteria-change table (Version 1.0 analysis limits, superseded, and the Version 2.0 criteria, in force). XMuLV clearance is judged on the mean predicted LRF at the least favourable NOR combination of the other factors, the quality attributes per batch.
The A-Mab concentration is measured by absorbance at 280 nm (AMV-3019); it is a parameter, so that AnalyticalMethod record has no associated attribute and no attribute_measured_by_method assertion.
The procedures table ties each validation reference to its title; each AnalyticalMethod record is anchored on both the methods-table row and the procedures-table row.
The platform worst cases the step verifies are statements anchored on the rows of the worst-case table; they are assumptions of upstream criteria, not criteria of this step.

The planned design matrices (Appendices A and B), the roles table and the factor letter codes are not represented row by row. No rhetorical_spans: none were curated for this plan. weak_claims is empty.

process_steps.description: The Protein A eluate is adjusted to the inactivation pH, held for a set time at a set temperature, then neutralized with base and filtered. The hold inactivates enveloped viruses and contributes a log reduction of XMuLV to the modular viral clearance claim. The same acid conditions can raise aggregate, fragments and acidic variants in the pool.

source_references.quote: Low-pH viral inactivation holds the Protein A eluate at acid pH for a set time and then neutralizes it.
Low-pH viral inactivation is the step after Protein A capture and before cation exchange chromatography.
The neutralized pool is the load of cation exchange.
Development site | Cambridge, MA
Commercial drug substance site | Grafton, WI

statements.statement_text: Inactivation of an enveloped virus at low pH follows first-order kinetics.

source_references.quote: Inactivation follows first-order kinetics.

statements.statement_text: At acid pH partially unfolded antibody exposes hydrophobic surface, so aggregate forms for as long as the pool is held at low pH.

source_references.quote: Molecules with exposed hydrophobic surface associate, so aggregate forms for as long as the pool is held at low pH.

statements.statement_text: Aggregate formed in the hold is carried into cation exchange, the step that removes it.

source_references.quote: Aggregate formed in the hold is carried into cation exchange, the step that removes it.

statements.statement_text: The step sets one attribute, XMuLV clearance.

source_references.quote: The step sets one attribute, XMuLV clearance.

statements.statement_text: XMuLV clearance has very high criticality by rule, whatever its Tool #1 score.

source_references.quote: XMuLV clearance was assigned very high criticality by rule, because a viral contamination would harm the patient directly, whatever its score

statements.statement_text: Acidic variants are measured by icIEF throughout the campaign.

source_references.quote: Acidic variants are measured by icIEF throughout this campaign, under the charge-variant procedure SOP-3013.

statements.statement_text: The mechanism of the step gives no reason to expect an effect of the A-Mab concentration on the inactivation of the virus; the univariate study tests that expectation.

source_references.quote: The mechanism of the step gives no reason to expect an effect of the antibody concentration on the inactivation of the virus, which acts on the viral envelope.

statements.statement_text: The scale-down model is qualified for each output separately, by its offset from manufacturing scale and not by a test of equivalence.

source_references.quote: The model is qualified for each output separately, by its offset from manufacturing scale and not by a test of equivalence (PCMP-001 §7.1).

statements.statement_text: The qualification decision needs the response-surface model and is made at the analysis, in PCR-006.

source_references.quote: The decision is therefore made at the analysis, in PCR-006.

statements.statement_text: Fragments and XMuLV clearance are not compared at both scales, so their offsets are unknown and they are judged as the model predicts them.

source_references.quote: Fragments and XMuLV clearance are not compared at both scales, so their offsets are unknown, not zero.

statements.statement_text: XMuLV clearance is measured in a spiking model of the step, because virus cannot be introduced into the manufacturing process.

source_references.quote: Virus cannot be introduced into the manufacturing process, so XMuLV clearance is measured in a spiking model of the step

statements.statement_text: Each run of a design is made as a spiked run, which gives the two titres, and an unspiked run at the same settings, which gives the quality attributes.

source_references.quote: The spiked run gives the two titres, and an unspiked run at the same settings gives the quality attributes.

statements.statement_text: The retained samples of the response-surface design are tested by nrCE-SDS in the re-test study S-VI-RET, and fragments are judged on those results.

source_references.quote: The retained samples of the response-surface design are tested by nrCE-SDS in the re-test study S-VI-RET, and fragments are judged on those results.

statements.statement_text: The response-surface model is the predictive model; every prediction, every PAR and the verification of the platform worst cases in PCR-006 will come from it.

source_references.quote: Every prediction, every PAR and the verification of the platform worst cases in PCR-006 will come from it.

statements.statement_text: Aggregate, fragments and acidic variants are judged through a 95 % prediction interval of a single batch wherever a judgement supports a claim.

source_references.quote: These three attributes are therefore judged through a 95 % prediction interval of a single batch wherever a judgement supports a claim.

statements.statement_text: The centre of each design is the midpoint of the ranges studied, at pH 3.6, 120 min and 20 °C, and is not the set-point of any factor.

source_references.quote: The centre of each design is the midpoint of the ranges studied, at pH 3.6, 120 min and 20 °C.

statements.statement_text: A response-surface model is adequate only if predicted R² falls short of R² by no more than 0.2.

source_references.quote: Predicted R² falls short of R² by no more than 0.2, the limit on overfitting of PCMP-001 §7.2.

statements.statement_text: Lack of fit against pure error must not be significant at α = 0.05.

source_references.quote: Lack of fit against pure error is not significant at α = 0.05.

statements.statement_text: The intermediate acceptance criterion for Aggregates (HMW) at the low-pH viral inactivation step is the drug substance criterion carried back through a downstream clearance fold of 1.40 and an increase of 0.00, with no margin: ≤ 7.02. assertions.assertion_text: The inactivation pH is expected to govern XMuLV inactivation.

source_references.quote: The inactivation pH is expected to govern the step, because the envelope glycoproteins denature much faster with each small fall in pH near the operating range.

assertions.assertion_text: A longer hold gives a larger log reduction of XMuLV.

source_references.quote: A longer hold gives a larger log reduction at any pH and temperature, and a warmer hold speeds the denaturation of the envelope glycoproteins.

assertions.assertion_text: A warmer hold speeds the denaturation of the envelope glycoproteins, and so the inactivation of XMuLV.

source_references.quote: A longer hold gives a larger log reduction at any pH and temperature, and a warmer hold speeds the denaturation of the envelope glycoproteins.

assertions.assertion_text: A lower inactivation pH raises the aggregate that forms in the hold.

source_references.quote: A lower pH, a longer hold and a higher temperature each raise the log reduction of XMuLV, and each also raises the aggregate that forms in the hold.

assertions.assertion_text: A higher antibody concentration is expected to make aggregate form faster in the hold.
